# About the book

This book contains all the documentation for the paediatric concussion subtyping project of my PhD.
Each chapter is made of quarto (.qmd) files in the github repository [psvelayudhan/research](https://github.com/psvelayudhan/research).
R scripts are interwoven with the documentation by being [child-imported](https://bookdown.org/yihui/rmarkdown-cookbook/child-document.html)[^1] from R markdown files in the [psvelayudhan/subtyping-mtbi](https://github.com/psvelayudhan/subtyping-mtbi) repository.

[^1]: Not the same as sourcing R scripts.
The Rmarkdown files are structured to be executed sequentially, and each script reads in the data it requires and writes out the data for subsequent analyses to reduce their inter-dependence.

Because the scripts actually read and write to our lab's carbon share, most code chunks are set to not execute on render using the `eval=FALSE` flag.
To reproduce any of the analyses in this book, rendering the book is not enough; you must step through the linked source code yourself.
Occasional chunks that do run are self-contained and are expected to simply read and display output generated by the "serious chunks" that were manually run previously.
